paragraphs: Rav Dimi bar Sheshna, in the name of Rav: Gittin 62a; Menachot 90a. Yuchasin’s statement, “He was after Rava, with Rav Huna, son of Rav Yehoshua; another reading: Rav Dimi bar Chinena”—end of quotation—has no basis and is false.
